MOTION FOR TIME PAYMENTS FILED BY SHADI N. KHARSA IS GRANTED. DEFENDANT'S MOTION TO PAY IN INSTALLMENTS IS GRANTED AS FOLLOWS: (1) THE PARTIES AGREE THAT DEFENDANT'S JUDGMENT ON THE CROSS-CLAIM SHALL BE OFFSET AGAINST THE JUDGMENT ON THE PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM; (2) DEFENDANT SHALL PAY TO PLAINTIFF THE SUM OF $500.00 ON OR BEFORE OCTOBER 15, 2008; (3) THEREAFTER, DEFENDANT SHALL PAY $300.00 PER MONTH COMMENCING ON OR BEFORE NOVEMBER 15, 2008, AND CONTINUING ON THE FIFTEENTH DAY OF EACH MONTH SUCCEEDING MONTH UNTIL FULLY PAID; (4)THE STAY OF ENFORCEMENT OF THE OUTSTANDING WRIT OF EXECUTION SHALL REMAIN IN EFFECT PENDING THE OUTCOME OF THIS INSTALLMENT PAYMENT OF JUDGMENT; (5) IF ANY INSTALLMENT PAYMENT IS MISSED, THE REMAINING BALANCE OF THE JUDGMENT SHALL BECOME DUE IMMEDIATELY. BOTH PARTIES PRESENT. COMMISSIONER PAUL SLAVIT. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506)
